validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION/DUPLICATE: no concern -- real, well-documented, long-running trunk (ksonline.ru 2007, a substantive regional-business feature naming the pipeline verbatim including its Belokurikha branch, exact 325km length match); clearly the corridor continuation south of P2283 (Novosibirsk-Barnaul), not a duplicate of it or of the P3367/P3368 family (which is a separate 2016-2021 westward отвод off P2283 toward Rebrikha, not this southward corridor toward Biysk/Gorno-Altaysk/Belokurikha). SPEC/SCOPE CONCERN on Start=2006: ksonline.ru (2007) explicitly confirms 2006 as the completion year for only the Barnaul-Biysk PORTION (150km of the recorded 325km total) -- 'Протяженность завершенного в 2006 году магистрального газопровода Барнаул-Бийск — 150 км'. The SAME article describes the Biysk-Belokurikha branch (86.5km) as still under active construction as of May-2007, targeted for completion by Dec-2007, and never states when the Gorno-Altaysk extension itself was completed. So Start=2006 is CONFIRMED CORRECT for a major construction milestone on this corridor, but it is not confirmed as the completion date for the FULL 325km line as GEM records it (one row covering Barnaul through Gorno-Altaysk plus the Belokurikha branch). No corrected date is proposed here (none found this pass for the Gorno-Altaysk portion specifically) -- flagged for a future pass to pin down when the corridor reached Gorno-Altaysk itself. contested left empty: this is a scope/completeness flag on the existing value, not a specific alternative value to paste.
